entities.summary: Lucjan Trela was a Polish boxer associated with the Stal Stalowa Wola's boxing section. He competed in the men's heavyweight event at the 1968 Summer Olympics. At the 1968 Summer Olympics, he competed against George Foreman in his first Olympic bout. Lucjan Trela was a athletes & competitors from Turbia (1942-06-25, Turbia–2019-02-12).
